title: Distribution Strategy & Transformation Consultant - Contract role

title: AWS AI Solution Architect
description: AWS AI Solutions Architect Location: London Travel: Travel across Europe (Germany, Denmark, Netherlands, France, Spain, Switzerland) Full time- Permanent Role Overview As an AWS AI Solutions Architect, you will be a key member of Europe Account and Go-To-Market teams, responsible for shaping, selling, and demonstrating modern cloud and AI-led solutions for strategic customers. This is a highly customer-facing role spanning solution architecture, RFP ownership, PoC creation, and executive-level demonstrations, with a strong emphasis on AWS AI services and modern application architectures. This a delivery and pre-sales mix role with strong hands-on expertise. Core skillset is Full Stack architect with React + Java Spring Boot + AWS + GENAI (AWS Bedrock, Strands SDK and Agent core ). Key Responsibilities Customer Engagement & Pre-Sales - Act as a trusted technical advisor, leading deep architectural discussions across cloud, data, and AI. - Partner with sales and account teams to articulate the value of AWS and AI offerings. - Build strong relationships with senior customer architects, engineering leaders, and CIO/CTO stakeholders. Solution Architecture & AI Innovation - Design end-to-end AWS solutions covering AI/ML/GenAI, cloud-native applications, data platforms, and modernization. - Lead PoC and demo creation including GenAI, Copilot-style, and agentic AI demonstrations. - Define scalable, secure, high-performance architectures aligned with AWS best practices. RFPs, Proposals & GTM Assets - Own and lead RFP responses for AWS, AI, and cloud transformation initiatives. - Create proactive propositions and solution POVs for strategic accounts. - Conduct customer workshops and design sessions to co-create high-impact solutions. Alliance & Ecosystem Collaboration - Work closely with AWS Alliance Managers and partner teams. - Align solutions with AWS reference architectures, funding programs, and industry best practices. - Collaborate with internal practices to accelerate customer outcomes. Required Skills & Experience - 8+ years of experience in cloud architecture and solution design. - Strong hands-on expertise in AWS (compute, storage, networking, security, serverless, containers). - Proven experience with AWS AI/ML services such as Agent Core, Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, Comprehend, Textract, and GenAI patterns (RAG, copilots, agents). - Strong development experience in Java and/or Python, with frontend exposure to React or modern JavaScript frameworks. - Experience in application modernization, cloud migration, DevSecOps, and Infrastructure as Code. - 5+ years of customer-facing experience in consulting or pre-sales roles. - Strong presentation, communication, and executive storytelling skills. Nice to Have - AWS Certifications (Solutions Architect – Professional preferred). - Experience in Manufacturing, Automotive, BFS, or Utilites. - Multi-cloud exposure (Azure/GCP). - Additional European language skills. The focus is to act as the glue between clients, WPP teams on all things data. As such, you will need to organise, motivate and inspire to connect all (data and non-data) disciplines in delivering success for our clients. Gravitas and strong collaboration are essential.</p> <p><span style="font-size: 14pt;"><strong>What you’ll be doing:</strong></span></p> <p><strong>Team direction and oversight</strong></p> <ul> <li>Direct a team of data, technology and business consultants, analysts and engineers, overseeing client briefs and managing team workload.</li> <li>Direct and motivate the team to help them achieve their goals and deliver brilliant work for VML’s clients.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Data & Analytics leadership</strong></p> <ul> <li>Act as strategic partner and advisor, helping clients to leverage the power of data, martech, analytics and AI to achieve their goals and drive effectiveness and efficiency.</li> <li>Develop proposals and methodologies for <ul> <li>Data Planning; encompassing data-driven journey design, targeting personalisation, test and learn</li> <li>Analytics & Data Science solutions; encompassing customer analytics (e.g. customer segmentation, predictive modelling), digital analytics (e.g. journey analysis, web/app, media analysis), business intelligence (e.g. dashboard reporting) and AI (e.g. conversational BI)</li> <li>Data & Analytics consulting; encompassing data, marketing technology, AI and operations (process, skills, culture, business change etc.). Includes data, AI, martech and adtech transformation roadmaps, measurement frameworks and associated operating model development.</li> </ul> </li> <li>Inspire our clients and all of VML with thought-leadership and best practice.</li> <li>Work closely with our clients to help diagnose and solve their challenges, support their data & AI vision, and make it happen.</li> <li>Drive client success and satisfaction in all you do.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Business Development</strong></p> <ul> <li>New business – be a data and analytics lead for pitches to deliver winning proposals and presentations.</li> <li>New & Organic business – be relentless at bringing new ideas and opportunities to grow our existing clients and bring our data offer to clients who work with us in other disciplines.</li> </ul> <p><span style="font-size: 14pt;"><strong>What you’ll need:</strong></span></p> <ul> <li>Exceptional experience leading across data and analytics in a consulting/agency environment, setting up teams and operating models with clients</li> <li>A belief in the value of data-driven marketing & AI to deliver exceptional results.</li> <li>Experience of building relationships with clients from junior to C-suite and dealing with the different and complex personalities involved.</li> <li>Someone who can unify groups from across a wide skill set and unify them behind a clear brief or goal and deliver excellent work for clients.</li> <li>A candidate with the ability to engage people with their presentation skills but show excellent active listening to create clear actions which meet client needs.</li> <li>A person with a love for data-driven marketing and is constantly following trends to develop impactful and significant work for our clients.</li> <li>Significant experience at scoping, resourcing, and developing commercial proposals.</li> <li>Knowledge of data and analytics technologies across the marketing and digital ecosystem including media, commerce, social and digital platforms, CRM & loyalty</li> <li>Knowledge of analytics solutions and how AI can be leveraged in marketing to drive growth.</li> <li>Must have knowledge (you need not be a deep practitioner in all these areas, but do need have a good appreciation across them): <ul> <li>Data strategy consulting – data landscape (1<sup>st</sup>, 2<sup>nd</sup>, 3<sup>rd</sup> party data), data management, governance, roadmap and use case development</li> <li>Analytics & AI – segmentation, predictive modelling, measurement & reporting, AI marketing applications and product development</li> <li>Marketing technologies – data cloud solutions, clean rooms, analytics and reporting tools, CDPs, CRM / marketing automation, AI technologies</li> <li>Marketing operations – operating models, process design, governance, data culture and skills development, client enablement and business change</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <p>At VML, we are committed to fostering an all-inclusive work environment that is both rewarding and career-forward. Our Inclusion, Equity & Belonging initiatives, alongside the VML Foundation, reflect our dedication to giving back and making a positive impact in our communities and beyond. Our people are the heartbeat of our organization—creators, doers, innovators, makers, and thinkers—who drive not just marketing, but meaningful experiences that resonate in every action and interaction. </p> <p>VML is a WPP Agency. description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About AlphaSense: </strong></h2> <p style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit <span><a href="http://www.alpha-sense.com" target="_blank">www.alpha-sense.com</a></span>. Come join us.</span></p></div><p style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>About the Team:</strong></span></p> <p>Our diverse Product & Engineering team values innovation, collaboration, and the continuous improvement of our platform. We offer a dynamic work environment where employees can grow and thrive while working on cutting-edge technology that shapes the future of AI and search.</p> <p>At AlphaSense, we believe that diverse experiences and perspectives are critical to our success. description: What do we do? Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. The Role: Build the data, decisioning and automated systems that allow Paddle to take more good risk while reducing fraud losses, unnecessary customer friction and manual work. Paddle’s Merchant of Record model makes risk a critical part of the product and its economics. Seller quality, buyer fraud, payment acceptance, refunds, disputes, reserves and card-scheme exposure cannot be optimised independently. This role will connect those signals, identify where the largest value is being lost, turn risk priorities into working controls and workflows, prove their effect in production, and establish a durable owner once a capability becomes repeatable. This is not a strategy-only role and it is not ownership of a large operational team. It is a hands-on build role at the intersection of risk, data, product, engineering and operations. What you'll do: Work hands-on with SQL (Snowflake, dbt), Python, statistics and modern AI-assisted tools to explore data, test hypotheses, prototype controls and evaluate results. Map the end-to-end seller risk system, its data, decisions, controls, owners and failure points. Establish the baseline before building: fraud losses, alert yield, time-to-detect, exposure at detection and analyst effort, with losses reconciled with Finance. Own the health of live controls: every rule and check has an owner, an expected volume, a measured yield and alerting when it goes quiet or drifts, and every change is tested and impact-assessed before release. Build and maintain a labelled library of confirmed fraud cases and a shared fraud typology: the basis for rules now and for machine-learning models with Data Science later. Build a value-ranked portfolio of risk opportunities. Translate risk problems into clear product, data and engineering work with measurable acceptance criteria. Design seller risk tiers that set payout timing, reserves and limits, giving good sellers more room and tightening controls on riskier ones. Backtest rules and risk scores on point-in-time data, and design control experiments, shadow tests and phased roll-outs that measure both loss reduction and legitimate-customer impact. Produce decision artefacts that let senior leaders make trade-offs about risk appetite, engineering investment, customer experience and commercial growth. Stay with each major capability until it works in production, then establish its long-term owner and move to the next high-value problem. Expected 6 month outcomes: At least one major seller-risk journey has materially improved on agreed loss, approval, speed or manual-effort measures. Strong hands-on analytical ability, fluency in SQL (Snowflake, dbt or similar), Python and statistics, plus experience using LLMs on unstructured data such as website content or support tickets, with measured accuracy. Experience working with decision flow systems such as Tactile A record of turning ambiguous cross-functional problems into systems that were adopted and produced measurable results. title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer (Onboard Services)
description: UFORCE exists to make aggression unaffordable. Founded in Ukraine and headquartered in London, UFORCE is a defence-technology company with operations across Europe, the United States and Asia. UFORCE builds uncrewed vessels, ground robotics and aircraft, autonomy software, and the command-and-control layer that operates them together. Each platform is deployable on its own, and stronger as part of the system. Its product lines include the MAGURA family of uncrewed surface vessels, the NEMESIS family of strike platforms, the LIUT family of ground robotic platforms, and counter-UAS systems. About the role The Senior/Staff Software Engineer (Onboard Services) will design, build, and operate the software services that run on UFORCE’s uncrewed vehicles — spanning video streaming, telemetry, autonomy integration, vehicle control, health monitoring, navigation, and device integrations. You will turn independently evolved services into one secure, testable, and maintainable onboard platform. This is a hands-on software engineering role focused on production Python services, service architecture, messaging, and reliable operation on constrained Linux hardware, including Raspberry Pi, x86, and NVIDIA Jetson. You will also own the boundary between the vehicle and the backend: clear, versioned contracts with cloud services, deployment systems, video infrastructure, and operator interfaces that work over intermittent, low-bandwidth links. Working with backend, autonomy, hardware, QA, and field teams, you will make releases predictable and catch failures on the bench, not in the field. What you’ll do Define and evolve a unified onboard service architecture: service boundaries, messaging, configuration, startup ordering, readiness, watchdogs, and graceful degradation when dependencies or devices are unavailable. Build and migrate production services to shared patterns, using reusable libraries and a reference service template covering project structure, packaging, logging, health reporting, and lifecycle management. Standardise local service communication around NATS, with clear rules for integrating MAVLink, ZMQ IPC, and HTTP where appropriate. Design stable, versioned vehicle-to-backend contracts for telemetry, commands and acknowledgements, video metadata and control, configuration, health, and logs. Engineer for unreliable connectivity: buffering and store-and-forward, idempotent commands, explicit acknowledgements and timeouts, reconnection, back-off, and safe behaviour when the backend is unreachable. Implement secure-by-default services: least-privilege identities and messaging permissions, mutually authenticated and encrypted backend links, secure credential provisioning and rotation, sandboxed runtimes, and audit events for safety-critical commands. Strengthen automated testing across unit, contract, integration, simulation, and hardware-in-the-loop tests, with CI gates that catch regressions before release. Build safer release workflows with signed packages, dependency scanning, bench smoke and soak tests, staged fleet rollouts, and reliable rollback. Profile services and enforce practical CPU, memory, and latency budgets on target hardware. Improve field diagnostics through structured logs, metrics, standardised health reporting, post-mission log capture, and actionable runbooks. Document architectural decisions and service interfaces, communicate trade-offs clearly, and use AI coding tools to accelerate delivery without compromising quality. What success looks like Actively developed onboard services converge on a shared architecture, supported Python runtime, messaging model, and service template. Engineers can take a new service from an empty repository to running on a bench vehicle in a day or less, with less duplicated infrastructure code. Vehicle-to-backend contracts remain compatible as cloud and vehicle software evolve at different speeds, preventing integration failures in the field. Authentication, least privilege, secret handling, runtime hardening, and supply-chain checks are consistently applied across the onboard stack. Automated tests and bench validation catch defects before deployment, reducing issues discovered in the field. Releases move predictably from bench validation to pilot vehicles and the wider fleet, with clear readiness gates and rollback procedures. Services stay within resource budgets and remain diagnosable under hardware constraints and degraded connectivity. Architecture documentation and runbooks help engineering, QA, and field teams integrate changes and resolve failures faster. Required Qualifications 7+ years of professional software engineering , delivering and operating production services. Strong Python — experience designing and shipping production services, including asyncio, packaging, testing, and profiling; Node.js experience is a plus. Web development and API experience — experience building and evolving HTTP/WebSocket APIs and message-based integrations with versioned contracts. Development with AI tools — uses AI coding assistants/agents daily and can demonstrate how they apply these tools to design, implementation, review, and testing while maintaining high quality. Security-first engineering — has applied authentication/authorisation, secrets management, least privilege, and secure update practices in a real system. Testing and release discipline — has built test suites and CI gates for unit, integration, and contract testing, and shipped software through staged releases with rollback. Experience with simulators or hardware-in-the-loop testing is a plus. C++, Rust, or Go experience is a plus. UxV, robotics, or embedded/edge Linux experience is a plus (e.g., MAVLink, GStreamer, serial/CAN devices, or systemd services on constrained hardware). The nature of combat has changed. Why this role exists Every foundation model lab is solving the same problem: build more capability. Almost nobody is solving the harder one — what happens when that capability meets a real organisation and real people who have to relearn how they work. That's the adoption layer , still wide open, and Multiverse sits in the unique position to solve this problem with ten years of proprietary learner and employer data driven from 1,500+ companies that no one else has. Diagnose & Prescribe ( D&P ) is the engine room of that problem. This is a broad, domain-coherent, event-driven and increasingly AI-native estate. The dominant challenge isn't deep algorithmic difficulty in any single repo — it's holding the whole D&P picture, sequencing work across varied services, and keeping load-bearing decisions safe as the system evolves underneath you. Craft that's respected, not traded off. Strict typing, layered testing, ADRs, observability — and AI-native ways of working as the baseline, not an experiment. A company mid-transformation, told straight. Multiverse is rebuilding itself into a product-powered, AI-native company in real time. You're not inheriting a finished system — you're one of the people defining it. Recommendation & onboarding — turning a diagnosis into the right prescribed path and getting learners into it, where those decisions become visible to customers and learners. The platform arc — continuing to carve D&P logic out of the shared legacy monolith into dedicated services, while backing the newer AI-native product from beta toward scale. Coach and build the team. Raise the AI-native bar. Prove better discovery-to-build-to-review loops on your own team and share what works across engineering. Partner on strategy. Strong Python/TypeScript (if you don’t have Typescript, you will need to learn): React/Next.js (App Router, RSC, server actions), tRPC/GraphQL, Node/Express. PostgreSQL at scale via an ORM, with migration discipline on large, live schemas. Event-driven systems on a message bus (we use RabbitMQ) — versioned events, idempotency, backward-compatible migration. A high engineering maturity bar as second nature: typing, testing, feature flags, ADRs, CI/CD, observability. AI-native delivery in practice — you build daily with Claude Code, Cursor, or the current best tool, and understand context management, model selection, tool design, and the token economics that separate a prototype from an affordable production system. GitHub, CircleCI, Datadog. AI-assisted development is first-class, not bolted on. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide , including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences. Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform . We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team. Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies , We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading. About the Role: Camunda runs on trusted data for people and agents. The Holistic Data Platform (HDP) is how we get there: a data warehouse, consumption layer, and a context layer that agents use to answer questions about pipeline, bookings, ARR and product usage. We are hiring a Data Engineer who builds that platform and also cares whether the numbers are right, whether the business uses them, and whether an agent gives a correct answer on top of them. You will work directly with Corporate Strategy, Finance, Sales, Product, and Marketing leaders. What you'll be doing: Data Engineering: Agent reliability. Build evals for the agents that sit on HDP. Review their answers, find the wrong ones, and fix the cause in the data, the docs, or the prompt context. Pipelines and platform. Ingestion, orchestration, dbt, CI/CD, and cost control. Machine Learning: Help us figure out where customers are getting stuck and how we can better support them. Analytics Engineering Product Telemetry: Working with our product team to make sense of telemetry and build a better product for our customers. Data quality as a product. Define what “correct” means for each important metric, test for it, monitor it, and tell us fast when it breaks. Reconcile HDP against data sources. Enablement. Make it easy for analysts and business owners to get answers without you. What you bring: We’re looking for an experienced data engineer with ML/AI experience who’s comfortable working in an AI-native environment Ability and/or willingness to use Camunda’s product 5+ years of Data Engineering or ML experience Strong data modeling skills and several years of experience with dbt. Ownership mindset: we’re a small team and proud of our accomplishments Experience in deploying, operating, and evolving data pipelines in the cloud (batching and streaming) Knowledge of Infrastructure as code tools such as Terraform Strong communication skills, enjoys sharing knowledge and learning collaboratively Passion for clean code, adept at writing automated tests to maintain codebase quality and product excellence This role is an existing vacancy #LI-JS1 #LI-DNI What We Have to Offer: Compensation We offer competitive, fair, and transparent compensation. Salary ranges are location-based, with Standard and Major markets (global tech hubs) reflecting local competition. The Annual Total Target Cash (base salary + 100% variable target, where applicable) shown below spans from the minimum in a Standard market to the maximum in a Major market. Final offers depend on skills , experience , and location , and we typically hire in the first half of the range to allow room for growth: United States: $143,800.00 to $231,900.00 United Kingdom: £90,300.00 to £148,500.00 Singapore: S$178,600.00 to S$267,900.00 If you’re based elsewhere, you’ll be hired via Remote.com (our global employer partner), and your Talent Acquisition Partner will provide a personalized Total Rewards Calculator after your first interview. Equity: We also offer equity (where applicable) through our Virtual Stock Option Plan (VSOP) . Benefits & Perks We invest in your wellbeing, growth, and ability to connect, along with perks that support you no matter where you’re based. Our benefits are globally designed and locally delivered where applicable. Remote & Flexible: Work from anywhere with the setup that suits you, home office budget, co-working space support, and flexible time off to recharge when you need it. In Person Connection: We invest in meaningful face time through our Annual Kickoff (Vienna in 2025, Madrid in 2026!), team offsites, and Camundi Connection Budgets , including contributing to meetups while travelling,, and local gatherings with fellow Camundi. title: Paralegal
description: CUBE are a global RegTech business defining and implementing the gold standard of regulatory intelligence for the financial services industry. We deliver our services through intuitive SaaS solutions, powered by AI, to simplify the complex and everchanging world of compliance for our clients. Why us? 🌍 CUBE is a globally recognized brand at the forefront of Regulatory Technology. Our industry-leading SaaS solutions are trusted by the world’s top financial institutions globally. 🚀 In 2024, we achieved over 50% growth, both organically and through two strategic acquisitions. We’re a fast-paced, high-performing team that thrives on pushing boundaries—continuously evolving our products, services, and operations. At CUBE, we don’t just keep up we stay ahead. 🌱 We believe our future is built by bold, ambitious individuals who are driven to make a real difference. Our “make it happen” culture empowers you to take ownership of your career and accelerate your personal and professional development from day one. 🌐 With over 700 CUBERs across 19 countries spanning EMEA, the Americas, and APAC, we operate as one team with a shared mission to transform regulatory compliance. Diversity, collaboration, and purpose are the heartbeat of our success. 💡 We were among the first to harness the power of AI in regulatory intelligence, and we continue to lead with our cutting-edge technology. At CUBE, You will work alongside some of the brightest minds in AI research and engineering in developing impactful solutions that are reshaping the world of regulatory compliance. Role Mission This role provides legal support by managing documentation, conducting research, and assisting with contract administration. It ensures legal processes run efficiently and maintains organised records. The role supports the legal team with administrative and procedural tasks and basic contract management. Responsibilities Prepare, review, and organise legal documents and correspondence. Maintain contract databases, filing systems, and legal records. Comfortable using matter management systems and e-signature platforms. Conduct legal research and compile information for legal counsel. Assist with contract administration including renewals and amendments. Support simple contract negotiations including NDAs and events contracts. Coordinate document execution, notarisation, and filing requirements. Track legal deadlines, milestones, and compliance requirements. Support due diligence and regulatory filing activities. Respond to routine legal enquiries and escalate complex matters appropriately. What we're looking for Law graduate or equivalent legal qualification. Minimum 1-2 years’ paralegal experience, preferably in a commercial or in-house legal environment. With an objective to either train as a trainee solicitor or a barrister. Communication & Stakeholder Engagement: Communicates clearly and builds productive relationships with colleagues, stakeholders, and external parties. Problem Solving & Critical Thinking: Analyses complex problems, evaluates options, and recommends effective solutions. Collaboration & Teamwork: Works effectively within teams, contributing to collective goals and supporting colleagues. Continuous Learning & Development: Actively pursues learning opportunities and develops skills to improve performance and adapt to change. Time Management & Prioritisation: Manages time effectively, prioritises tasks appropriately, and delivers work to agreed deadlines. Quality & Attention to Detail: Maintains high standards of quality, ensuring accuracy and thoroughness in all deliverables. Adaptability & Resilience: Thrives in a fast-paced environment, manages uncertainty effectively, and maintains performance under pressure. Interested? If you are passionate about leveraging technology to transform regulatory compliance and meet the qualifications outlined above, we invite you to apply. Please submit your resume detailing your relevant experience and interest in CUBE.​ CUBE is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><h4><strong>Who We Are</strong></h4> <p>MAP | WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel. </p></div><p>Are you a marketing technology leader who thrives at the intersection of technology and business, capable of driving strategic initiatives and shaping the future of personalized customer experiences? Do you possess the ability to dive into the complexities of marketing platforms while effortlessly communicating their value to a room full of executives? Are you a trusted advisor, a skilled presenter, and a passionate advocate for innovation in the MarTech space, with a proven track record of leading and mentoring high-performing teams? </p> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW228640761 BCX0" lang="EN-GB" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW228640761 BCX0">Then you might be the </span></span><strong><span class="TextRun SCXW228640761 BCX0" lang="EN-GB" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW228640761 BCX0">Director of Solution Consulting</span></span></strong><span class="TextRun SCXW228640761 BCX0" lang="EN-GB" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW228640761 BCX0"> </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW228640761 BCX0">we're</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW228640761 BCX0"> looking for </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW228640761 BCX0">(EMEA focused)!</span></span><span class="EOP SCXW228640761 BCX0" data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <h2>What will your day look like?</h2> <p>As a <strong>Director of Solution Consulting</strong> and a key member of the Solution Consulting leadership team, you'll play a pivotal role in driving the strategic direction of our technology solutions. Reporting to the Senior Director of Solution Consulting, you'll be a trusted advisor, guiding our clients and internal stakeholders towards significant growth by deeply understanding their complex needs and crafting tailored, cutting-edge technology solutions. You will also be responsible for sharing the responsibilities currently held by the Senior Director of Solution Consulting. Our Solution Consulting team acts as the bridge between business goals and technological possibilities, translating complex requirements into clear roadmaps and innovative designs that empower our clients to thrive. You will be responsible for being a senior stakeholder who can deliver projects, stand up in front of clients, position map, steer conversations, and handle difficult conversations. </p> <p>Your responsibilities will include: </p> <ul> <li><strong>Strategic Leadership</strong>: Contributing to the overall strategic direction of the Solution Consulting team, aligning technology solutions with business objectives, and identifying opportunities for innovation and growth.</li> <li><strong>Client Engagement:</strong> Building and maintaining strong relationships with key client stakeholders, acting as a trusted advisor and thought leader on marketing technology trends and best practices. You will also network with our strategi partners. </li> <li><strong>Solution Design & Implementation:</strong> Overseeing the design and implementation of complex marketing technology solutions, ensuring alignment with client requirements and industry best practices.</li> <li><strong>New Business Development</strong>: Actively participating in new business pursuits, including leading presentations, developing proposals, and contributing to RFIs and RFPs.</li> <li><strong>Vendor Relationships:</strong> Cultivating and maintaining strong relationships with key technology vendors (Adobe, Salesforce, Braze, etc.), staying abreast of new product developments and identifying opportunities for collaboration.</li> <li><strong>Team Mentorship & Development</strong>: Mentoring and developing junior members of the Solution Consulting team, fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning.</li> <li>Presenting compelling cases and case studies at industry events.</li> <li>Serve as the go-to technical expert on client projects, working closely with internal teams (Technology, Data, Experience, Strategy).</li> <li>Act as a translator, transforming ambitious client goals into actionable technology strategies.</li> <li>Collaborate with our growth team on pitches, RFPs, and high-level scoping.</li> <li>Stay ahead of the curve by keeping your finger on the pulse of the latest marketing technologies and developing insightful points of view. </li> </ul> <h2>Who are you going to work with?</h2> <p>As a valued member of our Solution Consulting team, you'll benefit from a supportive environment where knowledge sharing and collaboration are paramount. You will be working alongside brilliant minds who are passionate about pushing the boundaries of marketing technology. You will be working closely with the Senior Director of Solution Consulting. </p> <p>You'll collaborate with a diverse network of experts across our global offices, spanning technology, data, experience, and client service teams. You will be a vital part of supporting all of MAP’s capabilities.  </p> <h2>What do you bring to the table?</h2> <p>We're seeking a highly experienced technology leader who embodies a rare combination of technical expertise, exceptional communication skills, and a drive to make a real impact. </p> <ul> <li>You bring a passion for marketing technology and a genuine desire to make a difference for our clients and MAP.</li> <li>You have a proven track record of leadership and success in a solutions consulting or related role (e.g., technical consulting or customer success management) at a senior level, with experience managing and mentoring teams.</li> <li>You possess a strong foundation in Adobe Experience Platform (<strong>this is essential in our criteria for this role</strong>)</li> <li>You're a natural communicator with exceptional presentation skills, capable of captivating any level audience in speech, writing and PowerPoint.</li> <li>Proven experience building strong relationships and managing different stakeholders.</li> <li>Experience in direct new business development and business expansion. </li> </ul> <h2>A leader in personalized customer experiences</h2> <p>VML MAP is a world-leading Centre of Excellence that helps businesses humanize the relationship between the brand and the customer through hyper personalization at scale, marketing automation and CRM. With the brain of a consultancy, the heart of an agency and the power of technology and data, we work with some of the world's most admired brands to help them on their transformation journey to becoming truly customer-centric. Together, we are 1000 + technology specialists, data scientists, strategic thinkers, consultants, operations experts, and creative minds from 55+ nationalities.</p> <h2>A global network</h2> <p>We are part of the global VML network that encompasses more than 30,000 employees across 150+ offices in 60+ markets, each contributing to a culture that values connection, belonging, and the power of differences. </p> <p>#LI-EMEA</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span class="normaltextrun"><span lang="EN-GB">WPP (MAP/VML) is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system.</p> <p>Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.</p></div><h2>What's the opportunity? </h2> <p>We are looking for an experienced and ambitious Sales Manager to lead a team of Account Executives focused on acquiring and expanding relationships with mid-market customers. The ideal candidate combines strong commercial leadership with operational excellence, coaching capability, and a passion for building winning sales cultures in fast-paced SaaS environments.</p> <h2>What will I be doing? </h2> <ul> <li>Lead, coach, and develop a team of Account Executives</li> <li>Drive consistent pipeline generation, forecast accuracy, and revenue performance</li> <li>Support reps through complex commercial negotiations and multi-stakeholder sales cycles</li> <li>Build a culture of accountability, performance, and continuous improvement</li> <li>Partner cross-functionally with Marketing, Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, and Partnerships teams</li> <li>Recruit, onboard, and develop top sales talent</li> <li>Monitor key sales metrics and identify opportunities to improve execution and conversion rates</li> <li>Contribute to regional go-to-market planning and execution</li> <li>Ensure operational discipline across forecasting, CRM hygiene, and sales processes</li> </ul> <h2>What skills do I need? </h2> <ul> <li>Significant experience leading successful SaaS sales teams</li> <li>Proven track record of delivering and exceeding revenue targets</li> <li>Strong people leadership and coaching capabilities</li> <li>Experience managing complex B2B sales cycles</li> <li>Strong commercial acumen and forecasting discipline</li> <li>Ability to operate effectively across multiple European markets and cultures</li> <li>Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills</li> <li>Experience working in high-growth or scaling technology businesses is preferred</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Unleash Your Potential</strong></p> <p>When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. At Fin, we want to give people what they need to do the best work of their careers. Our benefits and programs are designed to support your health and wellbeing, your family, your time away from work, and your financial future. Offerings vary by location in line with local practices and requirements. Learn more about working at Fin and the benefits we offer at<a href="http://fin.ai/careers"> fin.ai/careers</a>. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Salesforce will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. </p> <p><strong>Policies </strong></p> <p>Fin has a hybrid working policy. We believe that working in person helps us stay connected, collaborate easier and create a great culture while still providing flexibility to work from home. We expect employees to be in the office at least three days per week.</p> <p>We have a radically open and accepting culture at Fin. We avoid spending time on divisive subjects to foster a safe and cohesive work environment for everyone. As an organization, our policy is to not advocate on behalf of the company or our employees on any social or political topics out of our internal or external communications. We respect personal opinion and expression on these topics on personal social platforms on personal time, and do not challenge or confront anyone for their views on non-work related topics. Our goal is to focus on doing incredible work to achieve our goals and unite the company through our <a href="https://www.intercom.com/careers">core values</a>.  </p> <p>Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. <a href="https://www.eeoc.gov/know-your-rights-workplace-discrimination-illegal">Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal.</a> Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.</p> <p> </p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Anthropic Fellows Program, The Anthropic Institute (Economics & Policy)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Anthropic</strong></h2> <p>Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.</p></div><h1><strong>Anthropic Fellows Program overview</strong></h1> <p>The Anthropic Fellows Program is designed to foster AI research and engineering talent. We provide funding and mentorship to promising technical talent - regardless of previous experience.</p> <p>Fellows will primarily use external infrastructure (e.g. open-source models, public APIs) to work on project aligned with our research priorities, with the goal of producing a <strong>public output</strong> (e.g. a paper submission). In one of our earlier cohorts, over 80% of fellows produced papers. We run multiple cohorts of Fellows each year and review applications on a rolling basis.</p> <p><u>Submit your application to the Economics & Policy workstream at the bottom of this page.</u> We are accepting applications on a rolling basis for the next cohort expected to start in January 2027. In some circumstances, we can accommodate fellows starting outside the usual cohort timelines — please note in your application if the January 2027 start date doesn't work for you.</p> <h2><strong>What to expect</strong></h2> <ul> <li>4 months of full-time research </li> <li>Direct mentorship from Anthropic researchers </li> <li>Weekly stipend of 4,615 USD / 3,440 GBP / 6,470 CAD / 4,110 EUR + benefits (these vary by country)</li> <li>Substantial funding for compute and other research expenses</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Interview process</strong></h2> <p>The interview process will include an initial application, assessments, and interviews. We may ask for references later in the process as well.</p> <p><strong>We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.</strong> Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. title: Senior Financial Control Analyst, 9 Month Fixed Term Contract
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p><strong>Senior Financial Control Analyst</strong></p> <p>📍London/Cardiff | 💰£56,000 - £75,000 + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a></p> <p><strong>⭐ Our Financial Control Team:</strong></p> <p>Monzo is growing fast - new products, new markets and new locations. As we expand we need to make sure we can support our businesses and control our processes, so we are growing our team to meet these exciting new challenges! We are looking to introduce a Senior Financial Control Analyst on a 9 Month Fixed Term Contract. </p> <p>Our team sits within Monzo’s Finance collective and our job is getting the numbers right. We’re currently a team of seven qualified accountants, split between our Cardiff and London offices, and we ensure the ledger’s correct at every month-end. We work closely with all areas of Finance and the product teams to make that happen.</p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by… </strong></p> <p>We're looking for a proactive, enthusiastic and commercially-minded accountant to work on our financial accounting, and help us build a world-class finance function. This role would be well suited to a qualified accountant with 2+ years of post-qualification experience.</p> <p>We have some really exciting challenges under way like making sure we maximise our new SAP S4/HANA general ledger, expanding into the European Union, pushing forward with our automation plans, continuing to grow our customer base, growing our lending business and adding to our marketplace. You’ll work on scaling Monzo in a controlled way, while helping us optimise our financial control processes with the help of technology. You’ll report to our Financial Control Manager.</p> <p><strong>Your day-to-day:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Manage a tight process with the rest of our internal Finance team to ensure a swift month-end close process and group consolidation.</li> <li>Understand the business and our products to write insightful management commentary.</li> <li>Understand our accounting systems and make sure we are taking advantage of all features we can to minimise manual elements of reporting.</li> <li>Embrace the opportunity to improve and transform processes, driving incremental improvements through to adoption of AI.</li> <li>Learn SQL skills to run reports and propose solutions that make our processes efficient and scalable.</li> <li>Support our year end process working with external auditors and our Financial Reporting squad.</li> <li>Help review new products, assessing the accounting and implementing them in our banking platform and accounting system.</li> <li>Work with the business to assess the impact of changes in accounting standards and make proposals on accounting policy matters for new products launched.</li> <li>Help maintain the integrity of our chart of accounts and financial static data.</li> <li>Resolve miscellaneous inquiries and support the overall finance team wherever needed - from forecasting and valuations, to bank transfers, transfer pricing and tax policy research!</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You’re a qualified accountant with a few years’ post-qualification experience, ideally in financial reporting/controlling teams and working in a retail banking environment</li> <li>You have a strong understanding of technical accounting standards</li> <li>You have a great eye for detail</li> <li>You’re fascinated by the banking and regulatory landscape, and have a good understanding of key financial controls</li> <li>You’re a self-starter and enjoy tackling what needs doing, whether it’s making a bank transfer or pulling together reports for investors</li> <li>You’re comfortable translating complex information into simple words for people with diverse backgrounds</li> <li>You’re interested in using data (SQL skills would be a bonus)</li> <li>You embrace change and are motivated to improve and innovate process</li> <li>You thrive in a dynamic and constantly evolving environment</li> <li>What we’re doing at Monzo excites you!</li> </ul> <p>🙌 What’s in it for you</p> <p>💰£56,000 - £75,000. </p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London or Cardiff office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London) </p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more!<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>Recruiter Screening Conversation </li> <li>Initial HM Interview </li> <li>Role Specific Interview </li> <li>Behavioural Interview </li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo.<a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo"> You can read them here.</a></p> <p>#LI-TP1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

title: Director, Maternal & Reproductive Health
location: United States, United Kingdom, Nigeria, Rwanda, Ethiopia, DRC, India
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span class="TextRun SCXW142035299 BCX0" lang="EN-US" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW142035299 BCX0">Resolve to Save Lives (RTSL)</span></span><span data-contrast="none"> is a global health organization that partners locally and globally to create and scale solutions to the world’s deadliest </span><span data-contrast="none">health threats. </span><span data-contrast="none">Millions of people die from preventable health threats. We collaborate to close the gap between proven, life-saving solutions and the people who need them. </span><span data-contrast="none">Since 2017, </span><span data-contrast="none">we’ve</span><span data-contrast="none"> worked with governments and other partners in more than 60 countries to save millions of lives. We work toward a future where people live</span> <span data-contrast="none">longer, healthier lives, communities flourish, and economies thrive. This is an ambitious vision, and it inspires us and our partners to make progress every day.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p></div><p><span class="EOP SCXW70040856 BCX0" data-ccp-props="{}">Resolve to Save Lives (RTSL) works with governments and partners to strengthen and transform primary health care (PHC) to improve health and save lives. Our approach focuses on making PHC more prioritized, proactive and accountable for outcomes, and strengthening how care is organized, delivered, financed and measured. Drawing on expertise across RTSL's portfolio, we bring together solutions in health system resilience and epidemic readiness, digital health and data-driven decision-making, performance measurement and improvement, and sustainable health financing. We apply these capabilities to address priority health challenges, including cardiovascular health, maternal survival and sexual and reproductive health, while strengthening health systems to deliver more equitable, effective and resilient care.  </span></p> <h3><strong><span class="EOP SCXW70040856 BCX0" data-ccp-props="{}">Position Purpose</span></strong></h3> <p>The Director, Maternal & Reproductive Health will provide strategic and technical leadership for RTSL's portfolio to reduce preventable maternal deaths and improve sexual and reproductive health outcomes. The role will lead the development and implementation of a multi-country program that strengthens government capabilities to identify and address barriers to quality care, translate data into action, and deliver measurable improvements in health outcomes.</p> <p>The Director will have overall accountability for the strategy, resources, quality, performance, and results of the maternal survival and reproductive health portfolio, leading a multidisciplinary team and working closely with governments, technical partners, and colleagues across RTSL to design, implement and scale evidence-informed approaches. The role requires deep expertise in sexual, reproductive and maternal health, strong program leadership, and the ability to translate technical evidence into practical, sustainable health system improvements.</p> <p><span data-contrast="auto"><strong>Work Location: </strong>100% Remote with travel as stated. </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto"><strong>Duration:</strong> Full-time employment for a fixed term of 24 months.</span></p> <h3><strong><span class="EOP SCXW70040856 BCX0" data-ccp-props="{}">Core Duties and Responsibilities</span></strong></h3> <h4><strong>Strategic</strong> <strong>Leadership</strong> <strong>and Portfolio Management</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Set the strategic direction, priorities and implementation approach for RTSL's maternal survival and reproductive health portfolio, exercising delegated authority to make program investment, resource allocation, and partnership decisions within approved organizational parameters and in alignment with country priorities.</li> <li>Oversee a multi-country portfolio, with accountability for program planning, budget development and management, resource allocation, performance and delivery against strategic objectives.</li> <li>Lead and manage a multidisciplinary team, establishing clear responsibilities and performance expectations, overseeing staffing and talent development, addressing performance and capacity gaps, and building the capabilities needed for sustained program delivery.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Technical Leadership and Program Development</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Provide expert technical leadership across maternal survival and sexual and reproductive health, including maternal death surveillance and response, quality maternal care, family planning, and adolescent pregnancy prevention.</li> <li>Lead the development and adaptation of evidence-informed approaches that connect data-driven learning with targeted improvements in clinical care, service delivery and wider health system capabilities.</li> <li>Guide the design and implementation of country programs, identifying opportunities to strengthen government leadership, institutional capabilities and sustainable approaches to improving health outcomes.</li> <li>Drive innovation and collaboration across RTSL's technical teams, drawing on expertise in PHC delivery, digital health, measurement and financing to address priority health system bottlenecks.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Country Engagement and Strategic Partnerships</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Lead senior-level engagement with Ministries of Health and national partners to identify priorities, shape country strategies and secure government ownership of programs and results.</li> <li>Develop and manage strategic partnerships with donors, multilateral agencies, technical institutions and implementing partners, identifying opportunities for collaboration, investment and program expansion, and representing RTSL in high-level technical and policy discussions.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Performance, Learning and Accountability</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Maintain overall accountability for portfolio performance and results, establishing clear performance expectations and monitoring mechanisms, and using evidence and implementation learning to inform strategic decisions, address delivery challenges, and adapt approaches.</li> <li>Oversee the generation, synthesis and dissemination of evidence and practical learning to inform policy, program improvement and scale-up across countries.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Qualifications</strong></h3> <h4><strong>Education</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Advanced degree in medicine, public health, sexual and reproductive health, obstetrics and gynecology, or a related field.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Experience</strong></h4> <ul> <li>At least 15 years of relevant global health experience, including substantial technical and leadership experience in sexual, reproductive and maternal health in low- and middle-income countries.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience developing and leading complex, multi-country programs, including strategic planning, budget oversight and accountability for results.</li> <li>Extensive experience engaging senior government officials, donors and international partners, with the ability to build relationships and influence strategic decisions.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Skills & Abilities</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Recognized technical expertise in maternal survival and reproductive health, with a strong understanding of evidence-based interventions, health service delivery and health system strengthening.</li> <li>Proven ability to lead and develop multidisciplinary teams and manage programs across different countries and organizational functions.</li> <li>Strong understanding of data-driven program improvement, implementation challenges and approaches to translating evidence into sustainable results.</li> <li>Excellent strategic thinking, judgement, communication and leadership skills, with the ability to navigate complex political and operational environments.</li> <li>Fluency in English title: Senior Finance Analyst
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London/UK Remote | £56,100 - £70,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance +  <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a></p> <p><strong>⭐️ Our Costs Team </strong></p> <p>We're looking for a Senior Finance Analyst to take a leading role in managing operating expenses across Monzo's Collectives and Disciplines, helping business leaders understand financial performance, anticipate emerging risks and make better-informed spending decisions.</p> <p>This role takes independent ownership of an allocated cost portfolio, combining financial planning, forecasting, performance management and commercial analysis. You'll go beyond maintaining accurate financial models and reporting to challenge assumptions, investigate complex cost drivers and recommend actions that improve financial performance.</p> <p>You'll work directly with senior business stakeholders, Finance Business Partners, Procurement and the wider Cost Efficiency team. You'll also help raise the standard of financial analysis across the team, supporting less experienced analysts and improving how we forecast, report and manage costs.</p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by…</strong></p> <ul> <li>Independently owning operating expense planning and forecasting for your allocated Collectives and Disciplines, building and maintaining robust financial models, challenging business assumptions and explaining material movements in the expected full-year position.</li> <li>Leading financial performance analysis for your portfolio, investigating complex variances across cost lines, suppliers and business activities, identifying underlying drivers and translating findings into quantified risks, opportunities and management recommendations.</li> <li>Driving monthly business performance discussions, producing and presenting decision-ready financial insight to senior stakeholders, confidently challenging expenditure, explaining forecast implications and securing agreement on actions.</li> <li>Providing financial analysis for material business decisions, evaluating new investments, supplier commitments, organisational changes and cost initiatives, including their affordability, in-year impact, annualised run-rate and expected financial benefits.</li> <li>Proactively identifying and delivering cost efficiency opportunities, partnering with Procurement and business owners to challenge existing expenditure, quantify achievable savings and track delivery against agreed financial baselines.</li> <li>Maintaining strong financial control and forecasting discipline, overseeing the quality of month-end actuals, accruals, forecast assumptions and financial commentary within your portfolio, resolving complex issues and escalating material risks early.</li> <li>Raising the capability of the wider analyst team, providing technical guidance, reviewing complex analysis, sharing financial modelling and reporting best practices, and helping less experienced colleagues develop their financial judgement.</li> <li>Leading targeted improvements to financial processes and reporting, identifying recurring weaknesses in forecasting, data quality or controls, and working with Finance Data and colleagues to implement measurable improvements in accuracy, efficiency and scalability.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have strong hands-on experience in FP&A, commercial finance or management accounting, including independent ownership of financial forecasts, management reporting and financial performance analysis.</li> <li>You're highly proficient in Excel or Google Sheets, with experience building and maintaining driver-based financial models, scenario analysis and reconciliations that other Finance colleagues can confidently review and use.</li> <li>You can demonstrate experience challenging forecasts and identifying the underlying business drivers of financial performance, rather than relying solely on historical variance analysis.</li> <li>You've independently prepared and presented financial analysis to senior business stakeholders, explaining complex financial matters, challenging assumptions and influencing decisions.</li> <li>You have experience evaluating business cases, supplier commitments or cost initiatives, including quantifying financial impacts, assessing assumptions and tracking expected benefits.</li> <li>You can demonstrate improvements you've made to financial processes, forecasting models or reporting, with measurable benefits such as improved accuracy, reduced manual effort or stronger controls.</li> <li>You've helped develop the technical capability of colleagues, through coaching, peer review, sharing modelling techniques or improving the quality of financial analysis across a team.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🙌What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £56,000 - £75,000 + Incentive Awards tied to performance. </p> <p>📍 This role is based in our London office, with a hybrid working environment with flexible working from home arrangements and some in-person attendance. We're open to distributed working within the UK (with the expectation of occasional work from our London office for key meetings).</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Read our full list of benefits<br><br></a></p> <p><strong>🌈</strong><strong> The application journey has these 3 key steps:</strong></p> <ol> <li>Phone call with recruiter (30 minutes)</li> <li>Role Specific with Hiring Manager & Finance Business Partner (45 Minutes)</li> <li>Behavioural Interview with Head of Department & Senior Finance Manager (45 Minutes) </li> </ol> <p>Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. </p> <p>Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out. <strong><em><br><br></em></strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

Mission. Action. Growth. Inclusion. Care.</p> <p>It's at the heart of everything we do. Within our People Collective, we're here to bring brilliant people together, build an inclusive culture and create an environment where everyone can do their best work. As Monzo continues to grow, our offices play an important role in bringing our people together. They're more than just places to work. They're spaces where teams connect, collaborate and experience what it means to be a Monzonaut.</p> <p>We're looking for an experienced <strong>Property & Facilities Lead</strong> to join us on a 12 month fixed term contract, covering caregiver leave. You'll lead a team of six across four office locations in London, Cardiff, Dublin and Barcelona, helping us deliver an exceptional workplace experience while managing and developing our global property portfolio.</p> <p>Reporting to the Head of Property, Culture and Engagement, you'll oversee our daily operations, lead strategic projects and collaborate with teams across Monzo to create safe, welcoming and engaging workplaces that bring people together and put the Monzonaut community first.</p> <h2><strong>🔑 You'll play a key role by...</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>🏢 Leading our global property and facilities operations</strong> – Overseeing our office locations, ensuring they're safe and compliant, while delivering a consistent and delightful workplace experience.</li> <li><strong>🚀 Managing and delivering property projects</strong> – Leading projects from planning to delivery, including office moves, refurbishments and new site launches. You'll manage timelines, budgets and internal and external stakeholders to deliver successful outcomes.</li> <li><strong>🌍 Supporting our global property strategy</strong> – Turning our longer term property ambitions into practical plans, ensuring our spaces meet the needs of our people and support Monzo's continued growth.</li> <li><strong>💪 Leading and developing a brilliant team</strong> – Managing six team members across all locations, setting clear priorities, supporting their development and building a scalable, high-performing function.</li> <li><strong>🤝 Collaborating across Monzo</strong> – Building strong relationships with Finance, Legal, TechOps and senior leadership to align priorities, influence decisions and deliver improvements.</li> <li><strong>💰 Managing budgets and suppliers</strong> – Overseeing property and facilities budgets, managing supplier relationships and ensuring we're delivering value for money across our portfolio.</li> <li><strong>🦺 Keeping our spaces safe and sustainable</strong> – Ensuring our workplaces meet health and safety requirements, managing compliance and working with the ESG team to deliver our Scope 1 and 2 environmental commitments.</li> <li><strong>✨ Continuously improving how we work</strong> – Using data and employee feedback to improve our spaces, streamline processes and build scalable ways of working. You'll also be happy to roll up your sleeves and provide hands on support when needed.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>🤩 We'd love to hear from you if...</strong></h2> <ul> <li>You have strong <strong>property and facilities management experience</strong>, ideally in a fast-paced, growing organisation with multiple office locations.</li> <li>You're an <strong>experienced project manager</strong>, confident leading complex projects end to end, managing timelines, budgets, risks and competing priorities.</li> <li>You're a <strong>confident people leader</strong>, with experience managing, coaching and developing high performing teams.</li> <li>You're <strong>commercially minded</strong>, with experience managing budgets, suppliers and contracts while balancing cost, quality and employee experience.</li> <li>You're a <strong>strong communicator and collaborator</strong>, comfortable working with senior stakeholders and building relationships across teams.</li> <li>You're <strong>proactive, organised and adaptable</strong>, able to balance day-to-day operations with strategic priorities, navigate ambiguity and make decisions independently.</li> <li>You're <strong>data-driven</strong>, and can use insights to make decisions and improve processes.</li> <li>You have a good understanding of <strong>workplace health and safety</strong>, and are confident using digital tools such as Google Workspace and Slack</li> <li>[Nice to have] You have a formal health and safety, facilities and/or project  management qualification such as IWFM 7, NVQ, NEBOSH, PRINCE 2 or APM.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Not ticking every box? At Monzo, we're committed to building a diverse and inclusive team, and we care just as much about your potential as your experience. If you're excited about this opportunity and think you could make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.</p> <h2><strong>🙌 What's in it for you</strong></h2> <p>💰 £60k - £65k + Incentive Awards</p> <p>📍 This role is based in our London office, with a minimum of three days per week in the office. You'll also travel periodically to our Cardiff, Dublin and Barcelona offices.</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to manage your time in a way that works for you, your team and the role.</p> <p>📚 £1,000 annual learning budget to spend on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We'll provide you with a MacBook and the equipment you need to work effectively.</p> <p>➕ Plus lots more!<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <h2><strong>🌈 The application journey</strong></h2> <p>Our hiring process is designed to help us get to know you, your experience and how you approach real-world challenges.</p> <p>There are four stages:</p> <ol> <li><strong>Initial call</strong> – An initial conversation to learn more about you and share more about the opportunity.</li> <li><strong>Role-specific interview</strong> – A deeper conversation about your technical experience, project management and approach to leading a multi-site function.</li> <li><strong>Manager and leadership interview</strong> – An opportunity to explore your leadership style, stakeholder management and how you approach decision-making.</li> </ol> <p>We aim to complete the process in around 2–3 weeks and will be as flexible as possible to accommodate your schedule.</p> <p>We also have some guidance on using AI during your application and interview.<a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo"> You can read it here.</a></p> <p>#LI-OH #LI-LONDON</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. We have a preference for candidates in EMEA time zones.</p> <p>This is a unique opportunity for an <strong>astute and forward-thinking tax professional</strong> to build a tax function from the ground up at a profitable, fast-growing technology company. We're looking for someone with a keen interest in technology and how technology is changing the tax profession, who can translate that insight into a modern, effective strategy and hands-on execution.</p> <p>Reporting directly to the CFO, you will <strong>design and own the tax processes</strong> that support our global expansion. <ul> <li style="font-weight: 300;"><span style="font-weight: 300;">An exceptional academic track record from high school and university.</span></li> <li>Undergraduate degree in business, finance, style="font-weight: 300;">International travel 2-4 times a year for company events up to two weeks long.</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-weight: 300;">In addition we expect that you will match 300;"><span style="font-weight: 300;">Reliable, delivering high quality work that builds trust and confidence.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 300;"><span style="font-weight: 300;">Accessible, character.</span></li> </ul> <h3><strong>Nice-to-have skills</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Leadership ability</li> <li>Software or tech industry experience</li> <li>Public company finance and reporting experience</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 300;">We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation
